fonts.display: 'GeistSans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'GeistMono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

palette.name: Graphite Ink
palette.role: Primary text, headings, nav links, list markers — near-black with a faint cool cast gives ink-like density without the harshness of pure #000

palette.name: Hairline Slate
palette.role: Borders, dividers, card outlines, image frames — the workhorse neutral that defines structural edges across every surface

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark fills — the base layer everything sits on

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Secondary text, monospace body fills, subtle iconography — slightly warmer than graphite for code and terminal contexts

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Subtle surface lift, ghost button borders, soft section backgrounds — the second tier above pure white

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: High-contrast neutral action fill for primary buttons on light surfaces.

palette.name: Iris Glow
palette.role: Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Magenta Pulse
palette.role: Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Ember Orange
palette.role: Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast.

palette.name: Rose Hot
palette.role: Red text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases.
